from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DeferredTaxAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Deferred tax asset data from one quarterly financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period/date of the report (e.g., Q1 2021, 2021年3月31日)")
    asset_value_end_of_period: float | None = Field(description="Deferred tax asset value as of the report period end date")
    asset_value_beginning_of_period: float | None = Field(description="Deferred tax asset value as of the beginning of the report period (previous period end)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported values (e.g., CNY, 元)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported values (e.g., raw yuan, thousands)")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report (e.g., Q1 financial report, annual report)")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt from the report anchoring the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    deferred_tax_asset_records: list[DeferredTaxAssetRecord]
